host.description: Hostname or IP address of the PostgreSQL server

database.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to use

username.description: Database user account for Orthanc to authenticate as

password.description: Password for the database user (use secrets management in production)

maximum_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections to the PostgreSQL server

enable_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for connections to PostgreSQL

ssl_certificate.description: Path to SSL client certificate (PEM format, optional if SSL enabled)

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL client private key (PEM format, optional if SSL enabled)

ssl_ca_certificate.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying server identity (PEM format)

enable_connection_pooling.description: Enable connection pooling to reduce connection overhead

connection_pool_min_size.description: Minimum number of connections retained in the pool

connection_pool_max_size.description: Maximum number of connections allowed in the pool

connection_pool_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) to wait for a connection from the pool

tables_prefix.description: Prefix for Orthanc database tables (e.g., 'orthanc' → orthanc_studies, orthanc_metadata)

logging.description: Enable verbose SQL query logging for debugging (disable in production)
